senses.gloss:
बेकनाट बेकनाट, अस्, m., Ved. (according
to Yāska) a usurer.

बेकुरा बेकुरा, f., Ved. (probably connected
with बकुर), a kind of musical instrument (?), one
who plays a particular musical instrument?; (accord-
ing to the Nirukta) a voice, sound.

बेकुरि, इस्, f., Ved. = बेकुरा; (also written
वेकुरि, भेकुरि, भाकुरि.)
